newsitem.title: LATVIA: Daugavpils up on Latvian bourse, Unibanka slides.
newsitem.headline: Daugavpils up on Latvian bourse, Unibanka slides.

text.p: The Daugavpils motor chain factory maintained its bull run on Latvia's bourse while market leader Unibanka continued to slide, the Riga Stock Excgange said on Thursday.
Overall market volume was a lively 130,000 lats versus 105,000 lats on Wendesday.
Daugavpils soared to 1.20 lats from 1.05 lats in trade of almost 74,000 lats.
Unibanka slipped 3.0 percent to 1.94 lats in turnover of 25,500 lats.
